decisions.reason: As a multi-model formwork profile system with its own page, it fits the firm's core formwork and plant-engineering knowledge closely, so early feedback is likely to be absorbed and used to refine rather than abandon it.

Automated concrete distributor flow control is highly related to the firm's automation, software, and integrated factory expertise, making it a learnable extension even if its early market visibility was more limited.

The shuttering magnet block line is close to the firm's existing formwork offering, but as a more accessory-like product with lower web prominence it faces a somewhat higher discontinuation risk if demand proves narrower than expected.

Magnetic formwork strips are strongly complementary to the firm's established modular formwork systems and were given their own page, indicating a product the firm is well positioned to improve and retain.
This magnetic formwork component builds directly on the firm's related engineering and production knowledge and was actively presented, so management would be inclined to keep and iterate it.

Although this magnetic formwork component is still close to the firm's knowledge base, its lower prominence suggests a more tentative commercial position, raising but not dominating the chance of withdrawal.
